content:
### **The Recurring-Service Advantage** 

Some trades sell a project. Others sell a relationship. Gutter cleaning, power washing, and exterior painting belong to the second category — services homeowners need repeatedly, seasonally, year after year.

For recurring services, the economics of customer acquisition are different. A roofing company can justify a high acquisition cost because one roof is a large ticket. A gutter cleaning company cannot — the value is in the repeat relationship, not the single job. That makes familiarity the single most valuable asset these companies can build.          

###  **Why Territory Presence Fits These Trades** 

A homeowner in Mequon does not comparison-shop gutter cleaning every spring. They call the company they remember. Structured neighborhood presence through SIT GroundForce™ makes your company the one they remember — before the season starts, before the need is urgent, before a competitor's postcard arrives. 

One approved partner per category per territory means that when your gutter cleaning or power washing category is secured in Cedarburg, Grafton, or the Lake Country corridor, no other company in the SIT™ program works those same streets in your category. 

### **Route Density — The Hidden Economics** 

Recurring exterior services are route businesses. Profitability depends on how many customers you serve per mile driven. Territory presence builds customers in clusters — the same neighborhoods, the same streets — which compounds route density season after season. Ten customers on three adjacent streets are worth more than twenty scattered across a county.
